en.name: Eucharistic Miracle of Morne-Rouge
en.summary: A Martinique village was spared the volcanic eruption that destroyed neighboring Saint-Pierre.
en.body: In 1902, the village of Morne-Rouge in Martinique was reported to have been spared the eruption of Mount Pelée that annihilated the nearby city of Saint-Pierre, with worshippers recalling a vision of Christ's Sacred Heart within the Host shortly before.
